Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/capabilities

src/agent_runtime/capabilities/init.py

Python · Tier A

Shared capability contracts and transitional registry composition exports.

Details

Skill implementations and composition live in agent_runtime.skills. Keep the documented package-level imports compatible without loading skills when shared base/registry modules are imported.

src/agent_runtime/capabilities/base.py

Python · Tier A

Define the minimal adapter extension contract around a source-owned ToolDefinition.

Responsibilities

  • Delegate argument validation to the tool definition and require concrete adapters to execute actual operations.

Boundaries

  • The base class supplies no execution, authorization or fabricated result. Registry/engine composition supplies those boundaries.

Lifecycle

  • An adapter attaches a ToolDefinition, validates invocation arguments, then implements execute for the selected operation/context.

State

  • The definition belongs to the adapter instance; this base owns no durable state or concurrency primitives.

Security

  • The default execute deliberately raises NotImplementedError so an unimplemented adapter cannot claim successful work.

Collaborators

  • ToolDefinition owns schema validation; ExecutionResult defines the result contract consumed by the execution engine.

Public surface

  • BaseCapability.validate_arguments delegates shape validation; subclasses must implement execute.

@see src/agent_runtime/tools.py

@see src/agent_runtime/execution/engine.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
BaseCapability 38 @brief Adapter extension point; subclasses attach a definition and implement real execution.
BaseCapability.validate_arguments 41 Apply the attached ToolDefinition schema validation and return its normalized argument mapping.
BaseCapability.execute 46 Require a concrete adapter implementation; the default always raises NotImplementedError. An implementation must return actual operation evidence as ExecutionResult, never inferred success.

src/agent_runtime/capabilities/registry.py

Python · Tier A

Register deterministic tools atomically and expose detached contract snapshots.

Responsibilities

  • Validate unique executable tool and skill ownership, including tools reused by guidance skills.

Boundaries

  • Registration alone does not enable a skill, probe a provider or authorize execution.

Lifecycle

  • build_native_registry registers packages; callers obtain snapshots or cheap identity/metadata inventories for policy and discovery.

State

  • The registry holds source-owned definitions and tool-to-skill ownership. Schema-bearing reads are detached; summary reads omit exhaustive argument/result JSON.

Security

  • Duplicate registration cannot replace an adapter or partially install a conflicting skill. Public copies prevent accidental changes to registered contracts.

Collaborators

  • tools.py validates contracts; capability_policy.py consumes IDs and summaries; native/catalog.py selects schemas for the accepted policy.

Public surface

  • register/register_skill add definitions; get/list_tools/selected_tools return snapshots; tool_ids/skill_summaries support bounded metadata work.

@see src/agent_runtime/tools.py

@see src/agent_runtime/capability_policy.py

@see src/agent_runtime/native/catalog.py
